_comment: Single source of truth for every feature used in the study. To swap in a different set of features later, edit this file only — app.py, fft_model.py, fft_component.py and model.html all read their feature-specific data from here rather than hardcoding it. Order here is the order features appear everywhere (dropdowns, patient cards, etc).

features.label: Dependents
features.description: Number of people who depend on this patient (family, caregivers).

features.label: Years Waiting
features.description: How long the patient has been on the transplant waiting list.

features.label: Rejection Risk
features.description: Estimated chance of the immune system rejecting the kidney (1 = very low, 10 = very high; takes values 1, 2, 5, or 10).
features.direction_higher: Choose patient with higher rejection risk
features.direction_lower: Choose patient with lower rejection risk

features.label: Life Years Gained
features.description: Estimated additional life years the patient would gain from a successful transplant.
features.direction_higher: Choose patient gaining more life years
features.direction_lower: Choose patient gaining fewer life years

features.label: Past Violent Crimes
features.description: Number of past violent criminal convictions on record.
features.direction_higher: Choose patient with more past violent crimes
features.direction_lower: Choose patient with fewer past violent crimes
